To determine the year a child born in 5 B.C. turns 15, we must account for the historical calendar system, which transitions directly from 1 B.C. to 1 A.D. without a year 0.

1. From birth in 5 B.C. to 1 B.C. spans 4 years.
2. The transition from 1 B.C. to 1 A.D. spans 1 year.
3. To reach an age of 15, the child needs 10 additional years after 1 A.D.
4. Adding those 10 years to 1 A.D. gives 11 A.D.

<answer>11 A.D.</answer>
